captures_note: each capture vs t0, same frozen rules and valid_frac>=0.85 gate; c1/c2 can differ in season from t0 (c2 is a 2026 scene), so their sev includes seasonal change

validation.caveat: Indices-and-rules baseline, not a learned model. OSM landuse=construction is a sparse, incomplete weak label (precision is understated, recall is of mapped sites only). Injected patches reuse real spectra of the same scene but have no real spatial texture. Seasonal/crop and moisture change can mimic change; outputs are leads needing verification.

injected.note: square pits, real water spectra, painted into dry sand bars; no real pit texture or edges

s1_corroboration.note: per tile aggregate counts of 1-4 px VV>-3 dB blobs on water inside the corridor; positions are not stored; wind-roughened water and fixed structures also produce them; corroboration only, not a gate
